一个灯笼照亮的夜间集市，温暖的灯光来自画面左侧，身后是蓝色月光下的烟雾，与 [IMAGE 4] 完全一致。镂空黄铜灯笼与系着红色流苏的遮篷架在一根木杆上，悬于珠宝商的桌子之上，桌上堆满宝石碗、一碟珍珠、一尊黄铜龙像、一只鎏金小箱与带盖黄铜罐；残破的拱门在远处隐现；右侧有一只火盆。故事道具：一颗如 [IMAGE 6] 的鸡蛋大小切割红宝石、大块头强盗的木棒、一个带绳柄的木桶，立在一个直立的木桶上。任何地方都没有文字。从轴线的摄影机一侧看，老珠宝商位于画面左侧，Kekius 位于画面右侧。全片一个地点：所有情节都发生在珠宝商桌子正前方的同几平方米湿石板路上，在连续半分钟之内完成，摄影机始终保持在同一侧。固定的走位，每一场都一样：老珠宝商坐在桌子后面的画面左侧，始终待在那里看着；Kekius 站在离桌三步远的画面右侧，绝不离开那个点；两个强盗始终在他们之间，也就是画面中央。那只木桶从第一场起就放在 Kekius 右髋处一个直立木桶的桶顶上；它整个重量都压在木桶上，绝不悬空、绝不漂浮，并且它只移动一次，在第 5 场中，被剑尖从木桶上挑起送到 Gus 的头上。桌子、遮篷杆、灯笼与火盆在每一个较宽的镜头背景中都保持可见，使场景始终是同一个。每场都从前一场结束的地方精确接续：位置相同、姿态相同、道具相同、拿在手里的人相同。不会出现在此前已见过之外的任何东西或任何人：没有别的街道，没有房屋，没有新道具，没有额外人物。

一个场景，取自 1980 年代中期的一部黑暗奇幻长…

[STYLE + CAMERA + ATMOSPHERE]
A scene from a mid-1980s dark fantasy feature film, shot on 35mm colour negative and seen as a fresh release print: a rich, contrasty image with deep, dense blacks, bright glowing highlights and saturated colour, the warm firelight standing out strongly against dark blue shadow; halation and bloom around flames and highlights from lens diffusion, fine grain, never sharp or digital, never flat, grey or washed out. Warm amber firelight keys faces from one side while steel-blue moonlight backlights thick theatrical smoke. Everything is practical: a sound-stage gothic set, foam-latex animatronic creature puppets with glassy eyes and rubbery wrinkles, real sculpted costumes, hand-animated optical glows. Long-lens close-ups with shallow depth of field alternate with a few low wide shots. Distinct camera setups, hard cuts on action, brisk physical movement, no blood. Dialogue-led comedy: every scripted line is spoken clearly, in full, by the named speaker, with lips in sync and a beat of reaction after it. Dry comic timing and clear physical reactions. Framed for a 4:3 frame.

A lantern-lit night bazaar in warm lantern light from screen-left and blue moonlit smoke behind, exactly as in [IMAGE 4]. Pierced brass lanterns and a red tasselled awning on one wooden pole hang over a jeweller's table crowded with gem bowls, a dish of pearls, a brass dragon figurine, a gilt casket and lidded brass pots; ruined arches loom beyond; a fire bowl burns at right. The story's props: one egg-sized cut ruby as in [IMAGE 6], the big bandit's wooden club, one wooden bucket with a rope handle standing on an upright barrel. No lettering anywhere. From the camera side of the axis the old jeweller holds screen-left and Kekius holds screen-right. ONE PLACE FOR THE WHOLE FILM: everything happens on the same few square metres of wet cobbles directly in front of the jeweller's table, in one continuous half minute, and the camera always stays on the same side. Fixed marks, the same in every shot: the old jeweller sits behind his table at screen-left and stays there, watching; Kekius stands three steps from the table at screen-right and never leaves that mark; the two bandits are always between them, in the centre. The one wooden bucket stands on top of an upright wooden barrel at Kekius's right hip from the first shot; it rests on the barrel with its full weight, never hangs and never floats, and it only moves once, in shot 5, carried on the sword tip from the barrel to Gus's head. The table, the awning pole, the lanterns and the fire bowl stay visible in the background of every wider shot so the place is always the same. Each shot starts exactly where the one before it ended: same positions, same poses, same props in the same hands. Nothing and nobody appears that was not already seen: no other street, no houses, no new props, no extra people.

The comedy is played straight: the skinny bandit is frantic, Gus is serenely pleased with himself, and Kekius never raises his voice. [SHOT LIST]
Scene objective: A comedy of one honest fool. Two bandits snatch the old jeweller's ruby and run into Kekius, who is courteous and never hurries. The skinny one lies that they have no ruby; big Gus helpfully says where it is. Ordered to hit the frog, Gus gets a wooden bucket dropped over his head as a hat, swings blind and floors his own partner, delighted with himself. As Gus winds up to do it again, the skinny bandit, flat on his back, begs Kekius to take the ruby just to make Gus stop, and lays it on the offered blade. Kekius says two words and Gus sits down, on his partner. Kekius returns the ruby to the old jeweller, who thanks him with a tear of joy.

Scene objective: A comedy of one honest fool. Two bandits snatch the old jeweller's ruby and run into Kekius, who is courteous and never hurries. [SHOT LIST]
Scene objective: A comedy of one honest fool. Two bandits snatch the old jeweller's ruby and run into Kekius, who is courteous and never hurries. The skinny one lies that they have no ruby; big Gus helpfully says where it is. Ordered to hit the frog, Gus gets a wooden bucket dropped over his head as a hat, swings blind and floors his own partner, delighted with himself. As Gus winds up to do it again, the skinny bandit, flat on his back, begs Kekius to take the ruby just to make Gus stop, and lays it on the offered blade. Kekius says two words and Gus sits down, on his partner. Kekius returns the ruby to the old jeweller, who thanks him with a tear of joy.
Beat 1, the straight baseline and the glitch:
Shot 1 (0–2s) · Newly staged close medium at the jeweller's table. The old jeweller, behind his table at screen-left, holds the ruby of [IMAGE 6] up between finger and thumb, admiring it; the two bandits stand at the front of the table like customers, Gus beaming, and the skinny bandit's thin hand plucks the ruby clean out of the old man's fingers; both bandits turn away from the table towards screen-right; the old man stares at his empty fingers and gasps.
Shot 2 (2–5s) · Close medium, same place. One step from the table the two bandits stop dead, side by side, the skinny one clutching the ruby: Kekius Maximus at screen-right, three-quarter face, bare frog head with nothing on it, the crested golden helmet carried against his left hip in the crook of his left arm, gladius in his right hand, golden cuirass, red cape, smug half-smile, stands three steps from the table with the gladius held out level across their path; one wooden bucket stands on top of an upright barrel at his right hip, solid and still, well below his shoulder; the table and the old jeweller are visible behind the bandits at screen-left. Kekius Maximus, English, courteous: {Gentlemen. That ruby belongs to the jeweller.}
Beat 2, doubling down:
Shot 3 (5–7s) · Close medium of the skinny bandit, front view, Gus's shoulder beside him. In one clear movement he puts the hand holding the ruby behind his own back, so the ruby is gone from the front, and holds the other palm out empty, smiling far too widely. The skinny bandit, English, quick and oily: {What ruby? We have no ruby.}
Shot 4 (7–9s) · Close insert from directly behind the two bandits, at waist height. Against the back of the dark oversized coat the skinny bandit's thin fist clutches the sparkling ruby of [IMAGE 6], hidden behind him; Gus's thick finger comes into frame and points straight at it, and Gus's beaming face turns over his own shoulder at the top of the frame. Gus, English, friendly and slow: {It's behind his back. Shall I fetch it?}
Shot 5 (9–12s) · Close medium. The skinny bandit stamps on Gus's boot and points at the general. The skinny bandit, English, shrieking: {Hit him, Gus!} Gus takes two heavy steps towards Kekius with his club up; Kekius, without leaving his mark, slips the gladius tip under the rope handle of the bucket on the barrel at his hip, lifts it in one short arc straight from the barrel onto Gus, and sets it down, the bucket upside down over his whole head down to the shoulders. Kekius Maximus, English, polite: {Your hat, sir.}
Beat 3, heightening the absurdity:
Shot 6 (12–15s) · Low wide of the whole place: the table and the old jeweller at screen-left, watching open-mouthed, the two bandits in the centre, Kekius on his mark at screen-right, the barrel top now empty. Gus, the bucket upside down over his whole head down to the shoulders, turns round the wrong way, towards his partner, swings his club in a blind circle and bowls him onto the wet cobbles at his own feet. Gus, English, overjoyed, muffled inside the bucket: {I got him!}
Shot 7 (15–17s) · Close-up, down on the cobbles. The skinny bandit flat on his back between Gus's boots, hood over one eye, the ruby still in his fist, glaring up at the bucket. The skinny bandit, English, furious: {That was me, you fool!}
Shot 8 (17–20s) · Close medium, low, same spot. Bucket-headed Gus happily raises the club again right above his partner; Kekius, from his mark, lowers the flat of the gladius to the man on the ground like a tray, and the skinny bandit, still on his back, reaches up with both hands and lays the ruby on the steel. The skinny bandit, English, pleading: {Take it! Just make him stop!}
Beat 4, the peak disaster:
Shot 9 (20–22s) · Close medium. Kekius, the ruby resting on the level blade, turns his head to the bucket. Kekius Maximus, English, quiet, as to a dog: {Sit, Gus.} Gus lowers the club and sits straight down where he stands, squarely on his partner, who is still lying at his feet: the skinny bandit's striped legs stick out from under him.
Shot 10 (22–25s) · Close medium, over the general's golden shoulder. Kekius has only turned on his mark towards the table at screen-left: he reaches the blade across the table and the old jeweller, still in his seat, lifts the ruby off the steel with both trembling hands, his lined face breaking into joy. the jolly old jeweller, English, overjoyed: {My ruby! Bless you, with all my heart!}
Shot 11 (25–27s) · Extreme close-up. The old jeweller's narrow eye, shining wet, the ruby sparkling beside his cheek; one tear of joy runs down into his white moustache as he laughs and hugs the stone to his cheek.
Beat 5, the button:
Shot 12 (27–30s) · Close medium. Kekius on his mark at screen-right, bare-headed, helmet at his hip, gladius lowered, serene; right behind him in the centre, exactly where he sat down, Gus still sits on his partner with the bucket on his head, and the skinny bandit's arms wave feebly from underneath. Gus, English, hopeful, muffled inside the bucket: {Did we win?} Kekius Maximus, without turning round, English, bone-dry: {No, Gus. But you were essential.} Hard cut to black on his last word.

[风格 + 摄影 + 氛围]
一个场景，取自 1980 年代中期的一部黑暗奇幻长片，以 35mm 彩色负片拍摄，如同新上映的放映拷贝一般呈现：画面浓郁、反差强烈，黑位深沉厚实，高光明亮发光，色彩饱和，温暖的火光在深蓝色阴影中格外突出；火焰与高光周围有光晕与泛光，来自镜头漫射，细密颗粒，绝不锐利或数码化，绝不平淡、灰暗或褪色。温暖的琥珀色火光从一侧照亮面部，钢蓝色月光为浓重的舞台烟雾提供逆光。所有元素均为实物实拍：摄影棚内的哥特式布景，泡沫乳胶动画生物道具，带玻璃质感眼睛与橡胶感褶皱，真实雕塑质感的服装，手工动画的光效。长焦特写配浅景深，与少量低机位广角镜头交替。机位设置各不相同，动作处硬切，肢体动作 brisk，无血腥。以对白为主的喜剧：每一句剧本台词都由指定角色清晰、完整地说出，口型同步，说完后留一拍反应。干涩的喜剧节奏与清晰的肢体反应。按 4:3 画幅构图。

[镜头清单]
场景目标：一场关于一个诚实傻瓜的喜剧。两个强盗抢走老珠宝商的红宝石，撞上了 Kekius，他彬彬有礼且从不着急。瘦的那个撒谎说他们没有红宝石；大块头 Gus 却热心地说了红宝石在哪里。奉命去打这只青蛙，Gus 头上被扣了一只木桶当帽子，他闭着眼睛挥棒，把自己搭档撂倒在地，还对自己得意洋洋。当 Gus 再次挥棒要打时，仰面躺着的瘦小强盗求 Kekius 收走红宝石，只为让 Gus 停下来，并把红宝石放在递出的刀刃上。Kekius 只说了两个字，Gus 就一屁股坐在了自己搭档身上。Kekius 把红宝石还给老珠宝商，老珠宝商以一滴喜悦的泪水向他道谢。

[STYLE + CAMERA + ATMOSPHERE]
A scene from a mid-1980s dark fantasy feature film, shot on 35mm colour negative and seen as a fresh release print: a rich, contrasty image with deep, dense blacks, bright glowing highlights and saturated colour, the warm firelight standing out strongly against dark blue shadow; halation and bloom around flames and highlights from lens diffusion, fine grain, never sharp or digital, never flat, grey or washed out. Warm amber firelight keys faces from one side while steel-blue moonlight backlights thick theatrical smoke. Everything is practical: a sound-stage gothic set, foam-latex animatronic creature puppets with glassy eyes and rubbery wrinkles, real sculpted costumes, hand-animated optical glows. Long-lens close-ups with shallow depth of field alternate with a few low wide shots. Distinct camera setups, hard cuts on action, brisk physical movement, no blood. Dialogue-led comedy: every scripted line is spoken clearly, in full, by the named speaker, with lips in sync and a beat of reaction after it. Dry comic timing and clear physical reactions. Framed for a 4:3 frame.

[SHOT LIST]
Scene objective: A comedy of one honest fool. Two bandits snatch the old jeweller's ruby and run into Kekius, who is courteous and never hurries. The skinny one lies that they have no ruby; big Gus helpfully says where it is. Ordered to hit the frog, Gus gets a wooden bucket dropped over his head as a hat, swings blind and floors his own partner, delighted with himself. As Gus winds up to do it again, the skinny bandit, flat on his back, begs Kekius to take the ruby just to make Gus stop, and lays it on the offered blade. Kekius says two words and Gus sits down, on his partner. Kekius returns the ruby to the old jeweller, who thanks him with a tear of joy.

The old jeweller, behind his table at screen-left, holds the ruby of [IMAGE 6] up between finger and thumb, admiring it; the two bandits stand at the front of the table like customers, Gus beaming, and the skinny bandit's thin hand plucks the ruby clean out of the old man's fingers; both bandits turn away from the table towards screen-right; the old man stares at his empty fingers and gasps.

One step from the table the two bandits stop dead, side by side, the skinny one clutching the ruby: Kekius Maximus at screen-right, three-quarter face, bare frog head with nothing on it, the crested golden helmet carried against his left hip in the crook of his left arm, gladius in his right hand, golden cuirass, red cape, smug half-smile, stands three steps from the table with the gladius held out level across their path; one wooden bucket stands on top of an upright barrel at his right hip, solid and still, well below his shoulder; the table and the old jeweller are visible behind the bandits at screen-left. In one clear movement he puts the hand holding the ruby behind his own back, so the ruby is gone from the front, and holds the other palm out empty, smiling far too widely. Against the back of the dark oversized coat the skinny bandit's thin fist clutches the sparkling ruby of [IMAGE 6], hidden behind him; Gus's thick finger comes into frame and points straight at it, and Gus's beaming face turns over his own shoulder at the top of the frame. [STYLE + CAMERA + ATMOSPHERE]
A scene from a mid-1980s dark fantasy feature film, shot on 35mm colour negative and seen as a fresh release print: a rich, contrasty image with deep, dense blacks, bright glowing highlights and saturated colour, the warm firelight standing out strongly against dark blue shadow; halation and bloom around flames and highlights from lens diffusion, fine grain, never sharp or digital, never flat, grey or washed out. Warm amber firelight keys faces from one side while steel-blue moonlight backlights thick theatrical smoke. Everything is practical: a sound-stage gothic set, foam-latex animatronic creature puppets with glassy eyes and rubbery wrinkles, real sculpted costumes, hand-animated optical glows. Long-lens close-ups with shallow depth of field alternate with a few low wide shots. Distinct camera setups, hard cuts on action, brisk physical movement, no blood. Dialogue-led comedy: every scripted line is spoken clearly, in full, by the named speaker, with lips in sync and a beat of reaction after it. Dry comic timing and clear physical reactions. Framed for a 4:3 frame.

[SHOT LIST]
Scene objective: A comedy of one honest fool. Two bandits snatch the old jeweller's ruby and run into Kekius, who is courteous and never hurries. The skinny one lies that they have no ruby; big Gus helpfully says where it is. Ordered to hit the frog, Gus gets a wooden bucket dropped over his head as a hat, swings blind and floors his own partner, delighted with himself. As Gus winds up to do it again, the skinny bandit, flat on his back, begs Kekius to take the ruby just to make Gus stop, and lays it on the offered blade. Kekius says two words and Gus sits down, on his partner. Kekius returns the ruby to the old jeweller, who thanks him with a tear of joy.

High-contrast black-and-white conceptual artwork, tall 9:16 vertical composition, mixed-media graphic style. Full bleed edge to edge, no frame, no border, no lettering.
BACKGROUND: a rich matte black surface with a fine pebbled leather grain and subtle diagonal texture, deepening to pure black at the corners and edges.
FINGERPRINT: one enormous white fingerprint fills the frame as the dominant graphic element, its outline a wide oval, slightly tapering toward the top. It is drawn not as solid lines but as hundreds of broken dashed strokes and short parallel bars with softly rounded ends, hand-painted with slight thickness variation, some strokes irregular and chipped. The ridges sweep in long concentric arches and whorls, curving up over the crown and down both sides, with a dense tight cluster of concentric rings in the centre.
TUNNEL: dead centre, the fingerprint ridges part to form a glowing opening — a soft luminous white corridor receding into the distance, its walls a smooth radiant gradient of blurred white and pale grey, brightest at the far end, dissolving into a bright misty haze that halos the centre of the print.
ZEBRA: inside that opening walks a single zebra, seen from directly behind, moving away from the viewer toward the light. Its body is compact and symmetrical, coat a crisp pattern of black and white vertical stripes, a dark mane standing up in a short brush between two rounded ears, a long thin tail hanging straight down the middle of its back, hindquarters rounded and hind hooves faintly visible in the haze. Its silhouette is sharp and dark against the glowing tunnel, its stripes echoing the ridges of the fingerprint around it.
LIGHT: soft white backlight pouring out from the tunnel mouth onto the zebra, rim-lighting its ears and flanks, a gentle glow bleeding into the surrounding ridges.
PALETTE: pure black, charcoal, soft white, pearl grey. Graphic poster feel, minimalist, surreal.

高对比度黑白概念艺术作品，竖向 9:16 高幅构图，混合媒介图形风格。满版出血铺满画布边缘至边缘，无画框，无边框，无任何文字。
背景：质感浓郁的哑光黑色表面，带有细腻的荔枝纹皮革颗粒与微妙的斜向纹理，向四角和边缘逐渐加深为纯黑。
指纹：一枚巨大的白色指纹作为画面的主导图形元素占据满幅，其轮廓为宽大的椭圆，向上略微收窄。它并非由实线绘制，而是由数百道断续的虚线笔触和短小的平行条构成，末端柔和圆润，手绘质感带轻微粗细变化，部分笔触不规则且有缺损。指纹脊线以长长的同心弧线和涡纹扫过，向上拱过顶部并向两侧下落，中央有一簇密集紧凑的同心圆环。
隧道：在正中央，指纹脊线分开形成一个发光的开口——一条柔和发光的白色通道向远处延伸，其壁面是模糊白色与淡灰色的平滑辐射状渐变，在最远端最为明亮，逐渐消融在一片明亮的雾气薄霭之中，在指纹中心形成光晕。
斑马：在这道开口内部，一头斑马正行走其中，从正后方被看见，背对观者朝着光亮方向前进。它的身体紧凑而对称，毛色是清晰的黑白竖条纹图案，两只圆耳之间竖立着一撮深色的短鬃，一条细长的尾巴笔直垂落在背部正中，后臀圆润，后蹄在雾气中隐约可见。它的轮廓在发光隧道前显得锐利而深沉，条纹与周围指纹的脊线相互呼应。
光线：柔和的白色逆光从隧道口倾泻而出洒向斑马，为它的耳朵和身体两侧勾出轮廓光，一层柔和的辉光渗透进周围的脊线。
色彩：纯黑、炭黑、柔白、珍珠灰。平面海报质感，极简主义，超现实。

STYLE: LIVING LETTERFORM CARICATURES

Create an experimental typographic character design
of [SUBJECT] where recognizable anatomy and lettering
become one unified graphic sculpture-like illustration.

C₀  IDENTITY PRESERVATION
    Identify the subject's most recognizable physical
    features, including hairstyle silhouette, nose,
    eyes, jawline, eyebrows, and signature expression.

    Reconstruct these characteristics using geometric
    letterforms and controlled negative space.

    The viewer should recognize both the subject
    and the typographic construction.

    ¬C₀ = generic mascot face / unrelated character
    silhouette / completely abstract identity.

C₁  TYPOGRAPHIC ANATOMY FUSION (master)
    Use the subject's name or recognizable initials
    as the primary structural foundation.

    Construct the head, hair, eyebrows, eyes,
    nose, mouth, and signature facial geometry
    through carefully manipulated typographic forms.

    Transform letter counters into eye shapes,
    rounded glyphs into facial masses,
    vertical stems into necks or structural elements,
    and curved strokes into hair or facial contours.

    Allow the letters and character features
    to share physical boundaries.

    The character and typography must feel
    inseparable rather than layered independently.

    ¬C₁ = portrait placed above a logo /
    unrelated typography / conventional wordmark /
    generic illustrated character.

C₂  CONSTRUCTIVIST GEOMETRIC ENGINEERING
    Surround key forms with precise thin-line
    circles, overlapping arcs, tangent guides,
    crosshair marks, dotted construction paths,
    baseline grids, and small alignment points.

    Use dramatic contrasts between massive
    filled black typographic forms and delicate
    hairline geometric construction elements.

    Every guide should appear to explain
    how the character's visual geometry
    was constructed.

    ¬C₂ = random decorative circles /
    excessive technical clutter / inconsistent
    alignment / meaningless geometry.

C₃  MICRO-STICKER INTERRUPTIONS
    Introduce isolated concentrations of small
    colorful cartoon stickers inside selected
    letter counters, along typographic edges,
    or within intentional negative spaces.

    Stickers should reference the subject's
    personality, career, recognizable accessories,
    or visual identity.

    Keep approximately 80–90% of the overall
    composition monochromatic, with sticker
    accents creating surprising pockets of color.

    Sticker illustrations should use bold outlines,
    simple expressive faces, and compact shapes.

    ¬C₃ = full-page sticker wallpaper /
    stickers covering the face / unrelated doodles /
    random colorful decoration.

C₄  GRAPHIC MINIMALISM + CONTROLLED COLOR
    Primary palette: pure black and warm white.

    Use one or two subject-adaptive accent colors
    within the sticker clusters.

    Typography should use exceptionally heavy
    geometric letterforms, clean sharp edges,
    strong negative space, and selective
    high-contrast curved structures.

    Background remains clean and pale.

    ¬C₄ = full rainbow palette / photoreal textures /
    3D material shaders / glossy effects /
    elaborate gradients.

C₅  EXPERIMENTAL IDENTITY POSTER
    Square or portrait editorial composition.

    Make the fused character-wordmark occupy
    most of the image.

    Preserve generous white space around the
    central construction.

    Integrate delicate registration geometry
    without obscuring the primary lettering.

    The final artwork should function both
    as a recognizable character illustration
    and a distinctive experimental identity mark.

    ¬C₅ = ordinary portrait / dense stickerbomb
    background / realistic scenery /
    conventional logo placement.

η   HONEST GRAPHIC RENDER
    Precisely engineered curves, confident typography,
    mathematically inspired geometry, clever facial
    abstraction, seamless letter-character integration,
    clean high-contrast shapes, and crisp print quality.

FORBIDDEN = ordinary text under a portrait ·
    generic icon · excessive color · random stickers ·
    unrelated geometric symbols · photorealism ·
    generic cartoon avatar · 3D CGI · watermarks.
